summary: The original F1-F3 probes now pass their expected checks. A startup race still lets a foreign page produce a false PASS without running Spellweavers Run.
blocking_findings: F4 [Blocker] review-a: New late finding; it produces a false PASS of the browser check. At scripts/old-browser-check.mjs:145-161,239-244, a process can bind port 5199 after the TCP check. Its Vite marker satisfies readiness while the script's own Vite child has not exited yet. A wrapped race fixture served a foreign page and the script exited 0 with five moves. That page never loaded the game. Require readiness from the successfully bound child, and fail on child exit before accepting the browser result.
nonblocking_findings: F5 [Nit] review-a: New late CLI finding, tech-debt. scripts/old-browser-check.mjs:41-49 accepts a repeated `--game` pair despite the plan's extra-argument claim. An isolated parser probe accepted two valid pairs. The script still checks the same game; this does not yield a user-reachable wrong result or false PASS.
evidence: git rev-parse HEAD matches audited_head_sha at role start. The phase base resolves.
The phase diff adds the browser gate and its records. The remediation changes only the script and its records. Source, tests, Vite configuration, spec, and strategy do not change.

The sim sets chosen, adds word, collected and score, or decreases courage only in choose at src/games/spellweavers-run/core/sim.ts:142-170. Tick only resets word downward, recovers courage upward, and replaces rounds with chosen null.
The move predicate requires both marks. Clock fields, new round IDs alone, and missing state cannot satisfy it.

F1 closed for the original probe: the browser blocked every move input. Time advanced from 1666.67 to 6066.67 ms while score, collected words, courage, and chosen stayed unchanged. The script reported moves: 0 and exit 1.
Removing the state hook after mount also yielded moves: 0, state_changed: false, and exit 1.
F2 closed: the report write threw injected ENOSPC after a real browser run. The script exited 1 with one stderr line. The owned Vite and Chrome processes and listener were gone.

F3 closed for the original pre-bound probe: a foreign HTTP 200 responder was rejected in 251 ms with `port 5199 already in use`. The runner started and stopped that responder inside the same heavy-run call.

The race fixture pauses only after the successful free-port probe and before spawn. It binds a foreign fixture at that point. The original readiness and verdict logic accepted the foreign page despite no actual game mount.
The wrapped unmodified Green command exited 0 with two accepted actions, no browser errors, and four absent built-ins. It left a JSON report and two nonempty screenshots.

The wrapped harness checked port and process ownership after every probe. The final independent ss -ltn check showed no listener on 5199. The ps check found no Vite or Chrome process with the audit owner tag.
Syntax, focused Prettier, generator, and structural doctor passed. The build-graph database has no nodes table.
